selection_pipeline.name: normalize_brand_prompt
selection_pipeline.rule: Extract category, audience, positioning, mood, visual energy, asset availability, price tier, and conversion priority. Keep uncertain values as low-confidence rather than inventing facts.

selection_pipeline.name: select_theme
selection_pipeline.rule: Choose a typography and density system from the brand profile, then customize semantic colors. Do not use palette changes as a substitute for structural differentiation.

selection_pipeline.name: select_roles
selection_pipeline.rule: Map the page goal to roles such as orient, merchandise, educate, differentiate, reassure, engage, convert, and retain. Omit roles that have no credible content or asset support.

selection_pipeline.name: rank_components
selection_pipeline.rule: Score components by signal match, asset fit, conversion fit, visual energy, responsive safety, and adjacency compatibility.

selection_pipeline.name: compose_rhythm
selection_pipeline.rule: Alternate geometry, density, and image/text emphasis. Avoid adjacent same-family or same-geometry sections unless the page goal explicitly requires repetition.

selection_pipeline.name: art_direct_media
selection_pipeline.rule: Generate a product- and brand-specific image brief for every image slot. Keep all headline, subheadline, badge, and CTA copy as HTML/content slots.

selection_pipeline.name: responsive_review
selection_pipeline.rule: Review the mobile order, crop, interaction, and action visibility for every node before publishing.

selection_pipeline.name: quality_gate
selection_pipeline.rule: Reject generic imagery, unsupported claims, repetitive structure, inaccessible controls, and components with missing required slots.

scoring.scale: Each positive score is 0–1; penalties are 0–0.25.

composition_rules: Use one clear primary hero; a second hero-like full-bleed section must earn its place through a different job and geometry.
Do not place more than two dense sections consecutively.
Do not place more than two dark/high-contrast sections consecutively.
After a full-bleed image, prefer a contained or text-led section to reset reading rhythm.
Place proof near the first meaningful purchase decision, not only at the bottom.
Use a product grid after the hero when merchandising is a primary goal; otherwise earn the product grid through story or category orientation.
Do not use a testimonial component when there are no real reviews or permissioned customer statements.
When no product image is available, use a category-relevant contextual scene and label the component intent accordingly; never invent a packshot.
For regulated, scientific, or sustainability claims, require a source/disclosure slot before rendering the claim as factual.
Keep CTA language editable and separate from generated media.

image_art_direction.base_prompt: Premium ecommerce art direction for [product/category] by a [brand positioning] brand. Show [specific product, material, or use context] for [audience]. Compose [subject placement and safe area] with [lighting], [palette], and [surface/material cues]. Use [crop/aspect ratio]. The image must communicate the actual product world, preserve product identity, and contain no marketing copy, logos added by generation, UI, badges, or decorative text.

slot_guidance.context_background: Make the context legible: environment, material, ingredient, ritual, garment, room, or cultural cue must connect to the product.
slot_guidance.product_image: Prefer supplied real product assets. If generation is used, preserve truthful shape, packaging logic, and category cues; never imply the generated image is a supplied packshot.
slot_guidance.campaign_image: Use one dominant subject and leave a deliberately composed HTML text safe area.
slot_guidance.ugc: Use supplied, permissioned assets only; generation may create a campaign alternative, never a fabricated customer artifact.

reject_if: text is baked into the hero image
hero background is unrelated to product or brand context
more than three consecutive card-based sections appear without a layout reset
the same section geometry is repeated solely with a new color
primary CTA is not visible or understandable on mobile
the component uses hover to expose an essential action
trust claims have no source, disclosure, or real customer asset
animation is continuous, decorative, or incompatible with reduced motion
rounded containers, gradients, or glass effects are applied without a brand-specific rationale
an image crop removes product identity or makes the focal subject ambiguous
approval_questions: What job does this section perform in the page narrative?
Why is this geometry a fit for the brand rather than a generic default?
What actual product or brand context does each image communicate?
Can the copy be edited without regenerating imagery?
Does the page still make sense at mobile width and with reduced motion?
Is the next action clear without adding visual clutter?
